race.comment: CRUSADER KINGS (1) is a handy gelding resuming for the Jones yard. Boasts some handy Country Championship form from last prep that stacks up strongly for this and his recent trial win suggests he's come back in great order. Bullock's booking is another bonus. Looks the one to beat. CROOK (5) bounced straight back to somewhere near her best form last start when beaten a lip here. Drawn sticky but with a clever ride she can be fighting out the finish again. WAVE BREAKER (3) doesn't win out of turn but is ticking along nicely and is drawn well for Nock of a month between runs. Doesn't need to improve much to be there at the business end. ZARIZATYCOON (2) returns and has trialled well in readiness. Gallagher sticking is a good push too. Worth keeping safe.
